description: Another synthetic persona, with their own statements and messages.
workflow: Switch persona. Screen 1 through screen 4 recompute from that fixture.

feature: Link an SMS to its statement line
description: One debit that arrived as both an SMS and a statement line is counted once.
workflow: Match amount, date, and reference. Screen 1 shows one charge with both sources.

description: She can supply a name the dictionary does not have.
workflow: An unknown row on screen 2 takes the name she types. It sticks for her data and is marked user-supplied.

description: The hand-written patterns behind screen 2 can be opened and read.
workflow: Open the pattern list. Each pattern is the one screen 2 uses to name a string.

description: A mandate that exists but has not debited yet is still a commitment.
workflow: It appears on screen 1 as not yet debiting. No red highlight until a charge arrives.

feature: Two subscriptions of the same kind
description: Two music apps, or the same service twice, are called out together.
workflow: Screen 3 flags the overlap.

feature: A hike that came with a notice
description: A price rise that did have an email or SMS is still shown, at lower severity than a silent one.
workflow: Screen 3 shows the rise and the notice. It is not marked silent.

description: An annual charge due soon is easier to see than a monthly debit.
workflow: Annual rows on screen 1 sort upward and show the renewal date.

feature: Charge after she marked it stopped
description: A debit that posts after a stop is a new issue.
workflow: Screen 3 flags it. Screen 4 opens on the dispute step.

description: Three cheap months, then the real price, is a different event from a mid-plan silent hike.
workflow: Screen 3 labels it as an intro price ending, not as a silent hike.

description: A gym still charging can be shown as a daily cost next to the last visit.
workflow: Screen 3 shows the year and the per-day figure beside last opened.

description: What already left and what is committed next are different numbers.
workflow: Screen 1 shows the trailing year and the next-12-month projection, labeled separately.

description: She can see what leaves this month, including annuals that have not hit yet.
workflow: A strip on screen 1 lists the debits due this month.

description: She can mark each step as she does it.
workflow: Screen 4 steps can be checked. The year changes only when the money-stop step is checked.

description: A filled message is ready when the merchant or the bank needs a written complaint.
workflow: Screen 4 fills merchant, amount, date, and reference into a message she can copy.

feature: Watch until the next debit date
description: After a stop, Paytrace keeps looking for one more debit.
workflow: The row stays in a watch state on screen 1 until that date passes with no new debit.

description: A short tour of the four screens, and a plainer wording of the year.
workflow: The tour walks screens 1 to 4. A plain-language switch rewrites the year on screen 1 in shorter sentences.

description: A synthetic PDF statement can be read as well as the CSV.
workflow: Text extracted from the PDF joins the same pipeline as the CSV and lands on the same four screens.

description: More hand-written patterns, so fewer strings stay unknown.
workflow: Screen 2 names more narrations. Unknowns still stay unknown until she names them.

feature: Several small hikes as one creep
description: Four small rises over time are one signal, not four separate hikes.
workflow: Screen 3 shows the compounded rise from the first price to the latest.

description: A failed debit followed by a successful one means the merchant is still trying.
workflow: Screen 3 shows the failed attempt and the retry together.

feature: Share card of the annual number
description: The year, and the unused part of it, can be shared as one card.
workflow: From screen 1 or screen 3, she exports a card with the year total and the flagged total.

description: Apple, fuller bill autopay, SIPs, BNPL, and insurance free-look each get a path.
workflow: Screen 4 gains those versions. A SIP is not a leak by default. BNPL is a debt, with no revoke, same idea as the loan.

description: Live statements and mandates replace the synthetic fixture after consent.
workflow: She consents. The same four screens fill from the live feed. This is not in the prototype.

description: More than one person can sit on one year.
workflow: A household switch sums each person's four screens into one year. This is not in the prototype.

feature: Accounts, KYC, push, and a phone app
description: Sign-in, identity checks, reminders, and a native app.
workflow: Those wrap the same four screens. They are not in the prototype.

description: The brief says a careful hand-built dictionary beats a model on the cases that matter.
workflow: Not the translator. Screen 2 stays on the dictionary, plus a name she types herself.

description: Paytrace does not call a bank, NPCI, or a merchant to revoke.
workflow: Screen 4 remains the instructions. She revokes in her own UPI or card app.
